metadata.description: Plugins that solve foundational engineering problems in the brave new world of agentic engineering.

plugins.name: agent-works
plugins.description: Agent workflows rot the same way everywhere (a bloated AGENTS.md, one rule stated four times, task status in six places, sessions on one machine blind to each other), so give every kind of fact one home under .agents/ with a size budget, check them all with aw doctor, keep tasks and owed gates on a shared kanban board, guard the files and runs that need it, and coordinate locks, leases and learnings across projects through one CLI.

plugins.name: but-first-planning
plugins.description: A file-based planning + build workflow: author a language-agnostic spec, plan it, and build it with coordinated builder agents — the spec-* authoring skills, the plan-* backlog skills, the build loop, and an autopilot that chains it all, landing in a single .agents/plan/ workspace.

plugins.name: codebase-optimizer
plugins.description: Staged autonomous codebase optimizer: organize the file tree into AGENTS.md-hubbed progressive disclosure, decompose god-files and deepen shallow architecture, each behind CI-faithful validation with revert-on-red; hub verification, decision records and the glossary defer to agent-works.

plugins.name: agentic-teamwork
plugins.description: Deterministic version-control guardrails for mixed-skill teams — hooks that block commits to protected branches, force-pushes, secrets, and failing tests, in Claude Code, the terminal, and CI. GitHub and GitLab first-class.

plugins.name: workflow-studio
plugins.description: Blueprint-style visual studio for Claude Code dynamic workflows — node canvas, typed pins, lossless graph↔.js round-trip — plus a hand-authoring skill.

plugins.name: animated-storytelling
plugins.description: Narrative arc + visual design + motion craft for making ideas land: NCP storyform, hierarchy/type/color, and Motion v12 recipes.

plugins.name: write-like-me
plugins.description: Make Claude's human-facing prose sound like you — a calibrated always-on voice profile, AI-tell auditing, and hooks that learn from your style feedback.

plugins.name: code-diet
plugins.description: Your agent's code is tomorrow's context: code-diet makes the agent write only what the task needs, deletes what it didn't behind revert-on-red, and prices its own instructions like it prices your code.

plugins.name: plugin-workbench
plugins.description: A plugin's real cost is invisible until installed, and authoring one means guessing at unwritten standards — so make, measure, and fix plugins around one six-dimension rubric: author against it, score any plugin into an HTML scorecard with an adopt/rework verdict, and apply the fixes ranked by script-computed point delta.

plugins.name: perceptual-loop
plugins.description: An agent can't iterate on what it can't measure: reproducible shots, metrics that gate regressions, sheets the agent and you can look at, motion and audio checks, and a batched queue for the judgements only a human should make.

plugins.name: docs-parity
plugins.description: User docs drift because they ship after the code, so make them move in the same change: a writer contract, screenshots only from a deterministic capture harness, and one checker that finds missing, stale and broken docs in session and in CI.
